Cut‑Out Sorting Cards
Cut along the dashed lines. Draw a small picture in each card, then spread them on the table and let Seif sort them into two piles: alive and not alive.
Shuffle and play again next week — the three tricky cards at the bottom are the real test. An adult does the cutting.
giraffe car tree
chair human mug
plant lizard cat
worm doll fly
cloud wooden chair an egg
The orange cards are the tricky ones. A cloud moves but is not alive. A wooden chair was once part of a living tree, but the chair itself is not alive. An egg is
alive — there is a chick growing inside it.
